footer.tagline: Video Intelligence. Turn any video into text, knowledge and content ready to publish.
footer.madeFor: Made for people who live off video.

seo.title: Turn videos into intelligence
seo.description: Upload any video and get transcription, chapters, a summary, clips and a searchable knowledge base. Built for creators.

hero.subtitle: Upload any video or audio and get transcription, chapters, a summary, clips and a knowledge base where you ask and find the exact moment.

problem.title: Your videos have hidden value
problem.subtitle: Millions of hours of video are recorded every day, but most of that content is never put to use. Turning a recording into subtitles, articles, clips and summaries takes too much time.

howItWorks.title: From raw footage to ready content
howItWorks.subtitle: Four automatic steps. You upload the recording, the platform does the rest.

01.title: Upload
01.desc: Upload MP4, MOV, MP3, WAV or WEBM. Audio is extracted with FFmpeg automatically.

02.title: Understand
02.desc: Speech-to-Text generates the full transcription with precise, word-by-word timestamps.

03.title: Extract
03.desc: AI analyzes the content and extracts a summary, chapters, keywords and best moments.

04.title: Create
04.desc: Generate titles, descriptions, Shorts scripts and clips ready to publish.

differential.title: Not just transcription. Intelligence about your videos
differential.subtitle: Every processed video becomes part of a searchable knowledge base — from the exact moment to the ready answer.
differential.askYourVideoDesc: Ask in natural language and get the video, the moment and the answer.
differential.askYourVideoResultDesc: The topic comes up when the creator comments on the new trailer and compares it to the community's expectations.
differential.libraryDesc: The Google of your videos: search a topic and see which recordings already covered it.
differential.librarySearchPlaceholder: Which video did I talk about OAuth authentication in?

audience.title: Built for people who live off video
audience.subtitle: YouTubers, podcasters, teachers and journalists who need to get the most out of every recording.

youtubers.title: Turn long videos into ready content
youtubers.desc: Titles, descriptions, chapters and clips generated automatically from every recording.

podcasters.title: Show notes, clips and highlights
podcasters.desc: From a two-hour conversation to complete show notes and the best clips in minutes.

teachers.title: Classes become study material
teachers.desc: Summary, topics and supporting material generated straight from the class recording.

pipeline.title: One video. Multiple pieces of content
pipeline.subtitle: The same recording feeds your entire content calendar.
pipeline.footer: Everything ready to publish on YouTube, TikTok, Instagram and your newsletter.
